recentItems.title: "LIFE-ல நான் பார்த்த Failure!" Kayadu's Emotional Journey! SHOCK ஆன Manimegalai
recentItems.description:
Actress Kayadu Lohar joins Manimegalai for a candid and heartfelt conversation about her cinema journey, the success of Dragon, handling fame and success, family support, personal struggles, and her dreams for the future.

Kayadu Lohar opens up about how she deals with difficult moments, overthinking, success, and the importance of never giving up. She also talks about her close bond with her family and friends, her love for travel, her experiences working with different actors, and her desire to explore action films.

One of the most interesting moments of the interview is Kayadu Lohar recalling her unexpected meeting with Superstar Rajinikanth, how nervous she felt around him, and the sweet compliment he gave her.

Watch this honest, emotional and fun conversation between Kayadu Lohar and Manimegalai.
